title: Logistic Regression — A Score That Must Become a Chance
key_insight: Logistic regression bends the score through an S-shaped gate. The result can be read as the model’s estimated probability of the positive class.
body:
## A Score That Must Become a Chance

A spam filter adds clues such as suspicious links and unknown senders. The raw score can be any size, but a chance must stay between zero and one.

Logistic regression bends the score through an S-shaped gate. The result can be read as the model’s estimated probability of the positive class.

A threshold turns that chance into a decision. Moving the threshold changes which kinds of mistakes the filter makes.
common_mistakes: Treating the output probability as certainty.
Using the default threshold without considering error costs.
Explaining an odds change as the same-sized probability change.
mini_exercise: Draw the situation from “A Score That Must Become a Chance” with three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: It is a strong, explainable baseline for binary classification.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “A Score That Must Become a Chance” story, explain Logistic Regression without assuming the listener knows machine learning.
